description: This file defines the ProductOption entity class which models product options in the sales management system. It includes fields for sorting order, type, descriptions, merchant association, code, and read-only status, along with their getters and setters. The class is annotated for ORM mapping with JPA/Hibernate.

classes.name: ProductOption
classes.description: Entity representing a product option, including fields for sorting order, type, descriptions, merchant store, code, and read-only status, mapped to the PRODUCT_OPTION table.

methods.name: getProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the product option.

methods.name: getProductOptionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type of the product option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions associated with the product option.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for the product option.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product option.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the MerchantStore associated with this product option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a MerchantStore with this product option.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the descriptions list for the product option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptions list, converting from set if necessary.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts the descriptions set to a list, initializing if null.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the product option is read-only.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Returns the read-only status of the product option.
